verdict.rationale: Reader is designed as a pure HTTP/curl API (r.jina.ai, s.jina.ai) with a headless-mode Docker image bundling Chrome, LibreOffice, etc., explicitly for running it 'without building it yourself,' making it trivial to script in CI pipelines with header-based options like x-engine, x-respond-with, x-max-tokens for automation control. Missing for 10: no explicit CI-pipeline example/tutorial and community reports note occasional auth (401) failures needing API keys, which is a minor operational caveat rather than a core capability gap.
